title: Clarify federation operator recovery after an unresolved settings write
outcome: The federation operator guide names the actual supported recovery after a failed settings write, explains that the attempted image can later become durable, and makes peer re-verification after disable/re-enable explicit.
acceptance: The 500 guidance accurately describes current production recovery: resolve the persistence problem, arrange the normal operator restart, then re-read GET /api/federation to determine the durable state; it does not claim a supported reconcile endpoint or imply that the failed request rolled back.

The guide states that a later unrelated state save can persist the attempted settings, and that changed settings downgrade non-revoked peers to Enrolled, requiring fresh verification and explicit reactivation before new placement while retaining reservations.
The documentation is checked against the existing configuration, persistence and boot behavior; it grants no new agent restart/configuration authority and claims no unimplemented operator action.
